meta.name: proctmux-config
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, edit, explain, validate, or troubleshoot a proctmux.yaml/procmux.yaml file, add or change proctmux processes, configure lifecycle behavior such as stop signals/on_kill/autostart, customize unified-mode layout/keybindings/style, or enable Makefile/package.json process discovery. Use it even when the user says this casually, such as "add my dev server to proctmux", "fix this proctmux config", "write a config for these services", or "what YAML option controls focus".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会直接创建或修改 proctmux 的 YAML 配置文件，按官方规则校验选项、保留无关设置，并选择 shell 或 cmd 来生成最小可用的配置。
howto.when: 当你想新建、修改、解释或排查 proctmux 配置，例如添加进程、调整停止信号/自动启动、设置布局键位或开启自动发现时触发。
